visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white V-neck cardigan with a red heart patch, sits at a white table. A person's hands in a first-person perspective hold a deck of playing cards, flipping through them rapidly. The background features a brightly lit room with a Mount Fuji print on the wall, a white designer chair, and a cat tree. (2) The card-flipping stops on the seven of hearts. The person's hand rips a corner off the card and performs a sleight-of-hand motion, pretending to make the corner vanish. The woman watches with a focused, curious expression. (3) The person gestures toward a card box on the table. The woman picks up the box and searches it. The camera pans around the room, showing luggage and a television. Animated hearts float in the air. The hand presents a silver ring, but the woman remains focused on finding the missing card piece.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with casual dialogue between a man and a woman over a mid-tempo acoustic guitar track. Rhythmic shuffling sounds from playing cards occur repeatedly. (2) A sharp, distinct tearing sound (transient) punctuates the dialogue as the card is ripped. The male voice maintains a playful, instructive tone. (3) Rhythmic friction sounds signify hand movements. A subtle impact sound is heard as the woman handles the card box. (4) The BGM transitions into a slow, sentimental piano ballad. The male voice drops in pitch and volume, attempting an intimate proposal, but the female voice interrupts with high-pitched, insistent confusion regarding the missing card corner.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience through a subverted romantic trope. The video portrays a failed proposal where the woman is so engrossed in solving a magic trick that she completely ignores the romantic gesture (the ring).
